registration.error.account_changed_since.zh: 本次绑定与原报名选手不一致，请管理员核实
registration.error.account_changed_since.en: Your linked Steam account does not match the original registration. Ask an administrator to verify it.

registration.error.account_not_approved.zh: 请使用通过审核的选手账号报名
registration.error.account_not_approved.en: Register with an approved player account.

registration.error.admin_confirm_teams.en: Only an administrator can confirm the teams.

registration.error.admin_draw.zh: 只有管理员可以进行平衡分队
registration.error.admin_draw.en: Only an administrator can draw the teams.

registration.error.admin_remove_signup.zh: 只有管理员可以移除个人报名
registration.error.admin_remove_signup.en: Only an administrator can remove individual signups.

registration.error.already_on_team.en: You have already joined a team for this event.

registration.error.already_signed_up.en: You are already registered for this event.

registration.error.any_teams_confirmed.en: Individual signups are already on confirmed teams.

registration.error.bad_preferred_registr.en: The preferred team ID is not valid.

registration.error.cancel_individual_bef.en: Withdraw your individual signup before joining a team.

registration.error.cannot_leave_slot.zh: 只能退出你自己加入的位置，或该报名已不可修改
registration.error.cannot_leave_slot.en: You can only leave your own slot while registration can be edited.

registration.error.cannot_remove_captain.en: The captain's slot cannot be cleared.

registration.error.cannot_retract_formed.zh: 这是已分队或曾换入阵容的报名，原记录不能撤回
registration.error.cannot_retract_formed.en: You cannot withdraw a registration that has been assigned to a team or used in a lineup.

registration.error.captain_cannot_edit_c.zh: 队长不能修改已认领队员的账号资料
registration.error.captain_cannot_edit_c.en: Captains cannot edit the account details of a member who claimed a slot.

registration.error.captain_cannot_leave.en: Captains cannot leave directly. Disband the team instead.

registration.error.captain_must_transfer.en: Transfer captaincy or disband the team before leaving.

registration.error.captain_or_admin_remo.zh: 只有队长或管理员可以移除队标

registration.error.captain_or_admin_upda.zh: 只有队长或管理员可以修改队员
registration.error.captain_or_admin_upda.en: Only a captain or administrator can edit a roster member.

registration.error.captain_required.zh: 只有本队队长可以执行此操作
registration.error.captain_required.en: Only the team captain can do this.

registration.error.clear_captain_slot.en: You cannot clear the captain's slot. Disband the team instead.

registration.error.invalid_intent.en: Invalid registration option or reserve preference.

registration.error.logo_save_failed.zh: 队标保存失败，请稍后重试
registration.error.logo_save_failed.en: Could not save the logo. Try again later.

registration.error.reserves_not_open.zh: 正式分队完成后才会开放替补报名

registration.error.sign_in_to_leave.zh: 请先登录后再退出位置

registration.error.steam_no_unique_playe.en: This Steam account does not match a unique player profile. Ask an administrator to verify your identity.

registration.success.draw_unknown_playti.zh: ，{players} 名选手时长不可见，已按公开选手的中位时长参与平衡
